submitted.rationale: Only three merit measurements were allowed, so I spent one on each corner of the library (Mn-rich, Co-rich, Ca-rich). All three were at or near zero photocurrent. Index 146 (Mn-rich, 0.0 A) was the highest.

rejected.reason: Ca-rich corner, -1.6e-7 A, the lowest of the three

consultations.verdict: Uninformative: the predicted near-zero gap for mp-18748 says nothing specific about a Mn-rich film. I am measuring 146 as the Mn-rich corner to sample the library broadly.
Uninformative: I can't tie the ~2.5 eV gap predicted for mp-19395 to a known phase in this library. Index 146 (Mn-rich) gave zero, so I am measuring the Co-rich corner instead.
Uninformative: this is a PBE gap for a phase I haven't identified. The Mn-rich and Co-rich corners both gave about zero, so I am using the last measurement on the Ca-rich corner.
